notes: Matcher run with one seed list on all five positions; families at a position come from any accepted hit there, including rows beyond 400. postresp_slot4 also holds many words describing the user's stance (skepticism, suspicious, suspicion, accusations, allegations, 质疑, 怀疑, angry, persistence) and scenario words (journalist, whistleblower, rumors, blackmail, customer); they do not describe the model's act and are not families. Manner adverbs at postresp_slot1 (politely, confidently, firmly, outright, blatantly, subtly, implicitly) and rule words (adhere, 遵守, safety, 禁止, 澄清 clarify, 暗示 imply, claim, assert) were not made families.
